hooks.statusMessage: Checking for an untagged release version
hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)||exit 0; cd "$root"||exit 0; ver=$(grep -m1 '"version"' eir-ui/tauri.conf.json 2>/dev/null|grep -Eo '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+'|head -1); [ -z "$ver" ]&&exit 0; git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/v$ver">/dev/null 2>&1&&exit 0; case "$(git log -1 --format=%s 2>/dev/null)" in *"[release]"*);; *)exit 0;; esac; sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)||exit 0; gd=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)||exit 0; s="$gd/eir-release-reminded"; [ "$(cat "$s" 2>/dev/null)" = "$sha" ]&&exit 0; printf %s "$sha">"$s"; printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"HEAD is a [release] commit but the manifest version v%s has no matching git tag. If the automated gate is green and this is the intended release, cut the rolling release: git tag v%s to match the four manifests, push it, then delete the previous GitHub release and tag. If CI is not green or you are intentionally deferring, say so and stop."}' "$ver" "$ver"; exit 0
